titulo_video: The Inheritor: The Mystery of the Dark Inheritance

locucoes.text: It's a pleasure to finally meet you...
The night holds secrets that shouldn't even be whispered.
Her every step echoes through the hallway like a death sentence.
I am yours... You inherited me.
From your father.
I'm your 'inheritance'.
Noh Yeseul?!
That's my name.
Inheritance?! What do you mean?
Whoa! The drama just started at maximum level here.
The mood got heavy and the mystery only grows with each second.
What... what is this?
Is she... is she crazy?
Did she just say that?!
An inheritance? This has to be a joke.
From my father... he left everything to you.
Please, come in!
She walks like she's carrying the weight of the world on her shoulders.
He, on the other hand, doesn't know whether to run or face this mess.
Her silence is, without a doubt, scarier than any scream.
The guy is sweating bullets, poor thing, under all this pressure.
The tension between them is so thick you could cut it with a knife!
Anyway... to sum up the story.
My father... he left this behind.
He passed away, right?
...Yes.
I see. That's a lot to process.
Then, a gentle gesture emerges amid all this confusion.
Thank you.
Maybe... we can still understand each other.
You... aren't even a little sad?
Her father's death should be a shock, but something doesn't add up.
He watches every detail, desperately searching for a lie.
After all, her eyes say much more than her own words.
It's clear that something very dark happened in this family.
Right, even knowing about his death, she shows nothing.
Her coldness is enough to give anyone around the chills.
I... I don't know how to explain.
Here, take this.
The envelope she holds keeps the truth she's hidden for so long.
The cause of everything seems to be a history of domestic violence.
A dark room, screams, and pain make up this real nightmare.
Her memories are marked by deep emotional scars.
It's heartbreaking just to imagine what she went through.
The past doesn't die; it just transforms into trauma.
The guy is finally starting to understand the gravity of the situation.
That was the case. And then this happened.
Father? You called him father?
Haha... what do you mean by father?
Not to be presumptuous... but he wasn't one.
You know, things aren't what they seem.
So... can we move forward?
I... for my master... what did he do?
BOOM! The impact of the revelation hit everyone hard!
Gah! Why are you surprised?
So what? If he was like that, screw him.
Even though he didn't do anything for us?!
And live? Is that all that matters now?
The stress level is through the roof, people!
He died because of him! You don't know anything!
Ah... you're so intense.
!!? What are you doing?
!? This can't be possible!
Y-you backed away, but what is this?!
Y-you... who are you really?
I'm tired of all this.
Damn! I need to get out of here!
Hard hit! The conflict escalated way too fast for them.
Then follows the silence that comes after the storm.
The night continues, but nothing will be the same after this.
That damn father... it's all his fault.
The loneliness on the park bench hurts more than any punch.
But he's not alone, because someone was watching him from the shadows.
So you were here. Found you.
Want to sit? Thanks for waiting for me.
Two strangers united by the weight of a rotten inheritance.
Um... about what happened...
Sorry... for earlier. I lost control.
I got angry and... suddenly...
It's okay. You don't need to apologize, I understand.
Huh? You really don't care?
The detail of the beige coat reveals a delicate yet firm gesture.
There's no master who apologizes... that's just how it is.
I'm the master's possession? Huh?
The pieces of this puzzle are starting to fit together.
You want to know the truth?
Can I... show you?
W-what are you doing?! Stop that!
No need to ask. Just feel it.
I'll show you what I truly inherited.
My resolve... is what binds us now.
And the chapter ends on this insane cliffhanger! Want part 3?
